text: スペース　シャトル　コロンビアごう
note: Columbia was the first of NASA's real Space Shuttles to fly in space, in 1981. The Japanese names it; the English game says only "Space Shuttle", Columbia having been lost in an accident in 2003.
claim: Space Shuttle Columbia first flew in April 1981 and was destroyed during re-entry on February 1, 2003.

check.quote: Columbia was the first of five Space Shuttle orbiters to fly in space, debuting the Space Shuttle launch vehicle on its maiden flight on April 12, 1981 ... Columbia disintegrated on February 1, 2003, around 09:00 EST during atmospheric re-entry after a 16-day scientific mission.
